safetyIncident.summary: An earlier unguarded launch command opened the default local Foundry data path briefly and updated the selected world's lastPlayed/settings log before it was stopped. No DiceBox module was installed or activated there, and no DiceBox document mutation was attempted.
safetyIncident.correctiveAction: Added tools/foundry-server.mjs and npm run foundry:launch-guard; launches now require an explicit non-default data path and verified world identity, and execution is opt-in.

notProven: permissions, active-GM routing, document behavior, authoritative read-back, and recovery
nextGate: Provide an authorized license configuration for the disposable exact-target fixture or use an existing exact-target disposable server, then run the guarded launch and browser lane without touching default Foundry data.
